Graph Neural Networks, Step by Step.src: Graph Neural Networks, Step by Step

A 14-node sensor graph; click a node to.zh: 一个含 14 个节点的传感器图；点击某个节点使其特征产生尖峰；观察 K 轮消息传递如何扩散该信号。切换聚合方式（均值 GCN / 最大值 / 注意力 GAT），观察传播模式随之改变。随后，一个在 4 个已标注节点上训练的逻辑回归头部读出类别。
A 14-node sensor graph; click a node to.src:
A 14-node sensor graph; click a node to spike its feature;
          watch K rounds of message passing diffuse the signal.
          Toggle aggregation (mean GCN / max / attention GAT) and see
          the propagation pattern change. Then a logistic head trained
          on 4 labelled nodes reads off the class.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Gra.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@图 · 消息传递 · 传感器网络@@T3@@

Many applied data sources are graphs, no.zh: 许多应用型数据源是图，而非图像或序列。例如共享天气背景的空气质量传感器网络。由空间邻接关系相连的卫星瓦片网格。在交叉路口设有交通计数器的道路网络。对这类数据而言，自然的归纳偏置是@@T0@@消息传递@@T1@@：一个节点的预测应当取决于其自身及其邻域。
Many applied data sources are graphs, no.src: Many applied data sources are graphs, not images or sequences. A network of air-quality sensors with shared weather context. A grid of satellite tiles connected by spatial adjacency. A road network with traffic counters at intersections. The natural inductive bias for these is message passing: a node's prediction should depend on itself and its neighbourhood.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A GNN.zh: @@T0@@要旨。@@T1@@GNN 是一种感受野由图而非方形所设定的 CNN。每一层代表一跳；$K$ 层即可看到 $K$ 跳邻域。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A GNN.src: The slogan. A GNN is a CNN where the receptive field is set by the graph instead of a square. Each layer is one hop; $K$ layers see a $K$-hop neighbourhood.

For each node $i$, gather messages from.zh: 对每个节点 $i$，从邻居处收集消息，对其聚合（求和 / 均值 / 最大值 / 注意力），再通过一个小型 MLP 与节点自身的特征相结合。这就是全部配方。具体各种 GNN（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、MPNN）的区别在于它们如何选取消息函数、聚合器以及组合方式。
For each node $i$, gather messages from.src:
For each node $i$, gather messages from neighbours, aggregate
          them (sum / mean / max / attention), and combine with the
          node's own feature through a small MLP. That's the entire
          recipe. Specific GNNs (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, MPNN) differ in
          how they pick the message function, the aggregator, and the
          combination.

Click any node to set its feature to 1 (.zh: 点击任一节点，将其特征置为 1（并清除其余节点）。逐步经历 0、1、2、3 轮消息传递，观察数值如何扩散至邻域，再扩散至邻居的邻居。
Click any node to set its feature to 1 (.src:
Click any node to set its feature to 1 (and clear the rest).
          Step through 0, 1, 2, 3 rounds of message passing and watch
          the value diffuse to the neighbourhood, then to the
          neighbours-of-neighbours.

Click any node to spike its feature. Gre.zh: 点击任一节点以使其特征产生尖峰。绿色编码特征值（越深表示越高）。边表示图的结构；带虚线标注的节点是第 3 步所用的 4 个监督种子。
Click any node to spike its feature. Gre.src: Click any node to spike its feature. Greens encode the feature value (darker = higher). Edges show the graph; dashed labelled nodes are the 4 supervised seeds for Step 3.

Node classification with 4 labels.zh: 使用 4 个标签进行节点分类

Add a 2-class structure: 4 of the 14 nod.zh: 加入一个二分类结构：14 个节点中有 4 个被标注（红环与蓝环）。经过 $K$ 轮消息传递后，一个逻辑回归头部读取每个节点的表示并预测类别。你所见到逐渐浮现的边界是一个@@T0@@图感知@@T1@@分类器——红色种子的邻居往往被归为红色，依此类推。
Add a 2-class structure: 4 of the 14 nod.src: Add a 2-class structure: 4 of the 14 nodes are labelled (red ring vs blue ring). After $K$ rounds of message passing, a logistic head reads each node's representation and predicts a class. The boundary you see emerging is a graph-aware classifier — neighbours of red seeds tend to be classified red, etc.

The classifier is trained from scratch i.zh: 每当聚合器发生变化，分类器都会在你的浏览器中从零训练。调高 K：在 K=0 时，分类器只能看到 4 个已标注节点自身的特征，泛化很差。在 K=2 时，标签传播至邻居，预测有所改善。超过 K~5 后你会看到@@T0@@过平滑@@T1@@——每个节点的表示都变得一样，分类器坍缩到多数类。这是 GNN 已知的失效模式（Li 等，2018）。
The classifier is trained from scratch i.src: The classifier is trained from scratch in your browser at every aggregator change. Crank K up: at K=0 the classifier can only see the 4 labelled nodes' own features and generalises poorly. At K=2 labels propagate to neighbours and the predictions improve. Past K~5 you'll see over-smoothing — every node's representation looks the same and the classifier collapses to majority class. That's a known GNN failure mode (Li et al., 2018).

The oversmoothing curve — and why \"deep.zh: 过平滑曲线——以及为何「更深的 GNN」通常适得其反
The oversmoothing curve — and why \"deep.src: The oversmoothing curve — and why "deeper GNN" usually backfires

A natural instinct for any neural net: s.zh: 对任何神经网络而言，一种自然的直觉是：叠更多层，获得更大容量。对 GNN 来说，这却惨遭失败。经过若干轮消息传递后，每个节点的表示都变成其感受野的平滑平均；最终所有节点看上去都一样，分类器坍缩到多数类（Li 等，2018；Oono 与 Suzuki，2020）。
A natural instinct for any neural net: s.src:
A natural instinct for any neural net: stack more layers,
          get more capacity. For GNNs this fails badly. After a few
          message-passing rounds, every node's representation becomes
          a smoothed average of its receptive field; eventually all
          nodes look the same and the classifier collapses to majority
          class (Li et al., 2018; Oono & Suzuki, 2020).

Below: the same 14-node graph, three agg.zh: 下方：同一个 14 节点图，三种聚合器，K 从 0 到 8。追踪两项指标：未标注节点上的@@T0@@节点分类器准确率@@T1@@，以及@@T2@@节点间的特征方差@@T3@@（教科书式的过平滑诊断量）。观察准确率在 K=2-3 附近达到峰值，随后随方差收缩至约 0 而崩塌。
Below: the same 14-node graph, three agg.src: Below: the same 14-node graph, three aggregators, K from 0 to 8. Two metrics tracked: node-classifier accuracy on the unlabelled nodes, and feature variance across nodes (the textbook oversmoothing diagnostic). Watch accuracy peak around K=2-3 and then collapse as variance shrinks to ~0.

Solid: classifier accuracy on unlabelled.zh: 实线：未标注节点上的分类器准确率。虚线：节点间的特征方差（对数刻度）。三种聚合器叠加显示。
Solid: classifier accuracy on unlabelled.src: Solid: classifier accuracy on unlabelled nodes. Dashed: cross-node feature variance (log scale). Three aggregators overlaid.

@@T0@@The fix.@@T1@@\n Real GNN.zh: @@T0@@解决之道。@@T1@@真实的 GNN（实践中 $\le$ 2-3 层）不应加深。当你需要长程信息时，可使用@@T2@@残差@@T3@@连接（PairNorm、GCNII）、基于注意力的聚合器（GAT、GATv2），或带位置编码的图 Transformer。将朴素 GCN 叠加超过 4 层几乎总是有害的。
@@T0@@The fix.@@T1@@\n Real GNN.src: The fix. Real GNNs ($\le$ 2-3 layers in practice) shouldn't go deep. When you need long-range information, use either residual connections (PairNorm, GCNII), an attention-based aggregator (GAT, GATv2), or a graph transformer with positional encodings. Stacking vanilla GCN past 4 layers almost always hurts.

A natural question: which graphs can a G.zh: 一个自然的问题是：GNN 能区分哪些图？经典答案（Xu 等，2019；Morris 等，2019）：消息传递式 GNN 的@@T0@@表达能力至多相当于@@T1@@一维 Weisfeiler-Lehman 图同构检验（1-WL）。该检验为：
A natural question: which graphs can a G.src: A natural question: which graphs can a GNN tell apart? The classical answer (Xu et al., 2019; Morris et al., 2019): a message-passing GNN is at most as expressive as the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Lehman graph-isomorphism test (1-WL). That test:

Label every node with its degree (or any.zh: 用节点的度（或任何一致的特征）为每个节点打上标签。
Label every node with its degree (or any.src: Label every node with its degree (or any consistent feature).

Replace each label with a hash of (own l.zh: 将每个标签替换为（自身标签，邻居标签的多重集）的哈希值。
Replace each label with a hash of (own l.src: Replace each label with a hash of (own label, multiset of neighbour labels).

Repeat. If two graphs ever produce diffe.zh: 重复此过程。若两个图在任何时刻产生不同的标签多重集，则它们不同构。
Repeat. If two graphs ever produce diffe.src: Repeat. If two graphs ever produce different label multisets, they're not isomorphic.

1-WL fails on regular graphs with the sa.zh: 1-WL 在具有相同度序列的正则图上会失败（例如两个不同构的 6-环）。任何朴素的消息传递式 GNN 亦然。有两条前进之路：
1-WL fails on regular graphs with the sa.src: 1-WL fails on regular graphs with the same degree sequence (e.g. two non-isomorphic 6-cycles). So does any vanilla message-passing GNN. Two ways forward:

@@T0@@GIN@@T1@@ (Xu et&nbsp;al., 2019) —.zh: @@T0@@GIN@@T1@@（Xu 等，2019）——在选取合适的聚合器时可证明地达到 1-WL 上限：$h_v = \mathrm{MLP}\bigl((1+\epsilon) h_v + \sum_{u \in \mathcal{N}(v)} h_u\bigr)$。当你怀疑图的可区分性至关重要时，请使用它。
@@T0@@GIN@@T1@@ (Xu et&nbsp;al., 2019) —.src: GIN (Xu et al., 2019) — provably attains the 1-WL bound with the right aggregator: $h_v = \mathrm{MLP}\bigl((1+\epsilon) h_v + \sum_{u \in \mathcal{N}(v)} h_u\bigr)$. Use this when you suspect graph distinguishability matters.

@@T0@@Higher-order GNNs / k-WL.@@T1@@ Ag.zh: @@T0@@高阶 GNN / k-WL。@@T1@@在节点的 $k$-元组上而非单个邻居上聚合。表达能力更强，但代价为 $O(N^k)$。PPGN、$k$-GNN。
@@T0@@Higher-order GNNs / k-WL.@@T1@@ Ag.src: Higher-order GNNs / k-WL. Aggregate over $k$-tuples of nodes instead of single neighbours. More expressive but $O(N^k)$ cost. PPGN, $k$-GNN.

@@T0@@Subgraph GNNs / positional encodin.zh: @@T0@@子图 GNN / 位置编码。@@T1@@用结构特征（拉普拉斯特征向量、随机游走编码）增强每个节点。代价低廉，实践中往往已足够。
@@T0@@Subgraph GNNs / positional encodin.src: Subgraph GNNs / positional encodings. Augment each node with structural features (Laplacian eigenvectors, random walk encodings). Cheap and often enough in practice.

Scaling to million-node graphs.zh: 扩展至百万节点规模的图

A full-batch GNN forward pass on a graph.zh: 对含 $|V|$ 个节点、平均度为 $d$ 的图做全批量 GNN 前向传播会触及每一条边——内存与计算量均为 $O(|V| d)$。当节点数超过约 10⁶ 时，这便是难以承受的。有三条出路：
A full-batch GNN forward pass on a graph.src: A full-batch GNN forward pass on a graph with $|V|$ nodes and average degree $d$ touches every edge — $O(|V| d)$ memory and compute. Beyond ~10⁶ nodes that's prohibitive. Three escapes:

@@T0@@Neighbour sampling@@T1@@ (GraphSAG.zh: @@T0@@邻居采样@@T1@@（GraphSAGE，Hamilton 等，2017）。对每个目标节点，每层采样固定数目 $S$ 个邻居。每批次的代价变为 $O(B \cdot S^K)$，而非 $O(|V| d)$。
@@T0@@Neighbour sampling@@T1@@ (GraphSAG.src: Neighbour sampling (GraphSAGE, Hamilton et al., 2017). For each target node, sample a fixed number $S$ of neighbours per layer. Cost becomes $O(B \cdot S^K)$ per batch instead of $O(|V| d)$.

@@T0@@Subgraph sampling@@T1@@ (Cluster-G.zh: @@T0@@子图采样@@T1@@（Cluster-GCN、GraphSAINT）。划分或采样子图并在其上训练；子图内部进行完整的消息传递，忽略子图之间的边。吞吐量大幅提升，准确率仅略有损失。
@@T0@@Subgraph sampling@@T1@@ (Cluster-G.src: Subgraph sampling (Cluster-GCN, GraphSAINT). Partition or sample subgraphs and train on them; full message passing within, ignoring inter-subgraph edges. Much higher throughput at a small accuracy cost.

@@T0@@Layer-wise sampling@@T1@@ (FastGCN.zh: @@T0@@逐层采样@@T1@@（FastGCN、LADIES）。逐层独立采样节点。方差缩减技巧（重要性采样）可将梯度偏差保持在较低水平。
@@T0@@Layer-wise sampling@@T1@@ (FastGCN.src: Layer-wise sampling (FastGCN, LADIES). Sample nodes per layer independently. Variance-reduction tricks (importance sampling) keep gradient bias low.

@@T0@@Frontier methods (2024+):@@T1@@ Ne.zh: @@T0@@前沿方法（2024 年以后）：@@T1@@采用线性注意力的 NeurIPS 时代图 Transformer；预计算的位置编码；为服务端部署而将 GNN 蒸馏为 MLP。
@@T0@@Frontier methods (2024+):@@T1@@ Ne.src: Frontier methods (2024+): NeurIPS-era graph transformers with linear-attention; pre-computed positional encodings; GNN distillation into MLP for serving.

Library defaults: PyG and DGL ship all o.zh: 库的默认选择：PyG 与 DGL 均内置上述全部方法；大规模场景下实践中的首试方案是采用邻居采样 $S = 25, 10$ 的两层 GraphSAGE。
Library defaults: PyG and DGL ship all o.src: Library defaults: PyG and DGL ship all of the above; the practical first try at scale is GraphSAGE with neighbour sampling $S = 25, 10$ for two layers.

@@T0@@GCN.@@T1@@ Symmetric-normalised me.zh: @@T0@@GCN。@@T1@@对称归一化的均值聚合。最廉价，是默认的首试方案。
@@T0@@GCN.@@T1@@ Symmetric-normalised me.src: GCN. Symmetric-normalised mean aggregation. Cheapest, the default first try.

@@T0@@GraphSAGE.@@T1@@ Neighborhood samp.zh: @@T0@@GraphSAGE。@@T1@@邻域采样 + 均值 / LSTM / 池化聚合器。可扩展至大规模图。
@@T0@@GraphSAGE.@@T1@@ Neighborhood samp.src: GraphSAGE. Neighborhood sampling + mean / LSTM / pooling aggregator. Scales to large graphs.

@@T0@@GAT.@@T1@@ Attention over neighbou.zh: @@T0@@GAT。@@T1@@在邻居上的注意力。边权变为可学习且依赖于内容——对异构邻域颇为有用。
@@T0@@GAT.@@T1@@ Attention over neighbou.src: GAT. Attention over neighbours. Edge weights become learnable and content-dependent — useful for heterogeneous neighbourhoods.

@@T0@@MPNN.@@T1@@ The general framework.zh: @@T0@@MPNN。@@T1@@即上述通用框架；消息与聚合器可任意选择。
@@T0@@MPNN.@@T1@@ The general framework.src: MPNN. The general framework above; any choice of message and aggregator.

@@T0@@GIN.@@T1@@ Provably as expressive.zh: @@T0@@GIN。@@T1@@可证明地具有与 Weisfeiler-Lehman 检验同等的表达能力——当图同构确实重要时所需。
@@T0@@GIN.@@T1@@ Provably as expressive.src: GIN. Provably as expressive as the Weisfeiler-Lehman test — needed when graph isomorphism actually matters.

@@T0@@Graph Transformer.@@T1@@ Self-atte.zh: @@T0@@图 Transformer。@@T1@@在所有节点上的自注意力（带位置 / 拉普拉斯编码）。计算量更重；对全局结构有帮助。
@@T0@@Graph Transformer.@@T1@@ Self-atte.src: Graph Transformer. Self-attention over all nodes (with positional / Laplacian encodings). Computationally heavier; helps for global structure.

Where GNNs are the right tool.src: Where GNNs are the right tool

@@T0@@Molecular property prediction.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@分子性质预测。@@T1@@原子为节点，化学键为边。GNN（MPNN、SchNet、DimeNet、ChemProp）常居 MoleculeNet 排行榜前列；其归纳偏置与化学的局域性相契合。
@@T0@@Molecular property prediction.@@T1.src: Molecular property prediction. Atoms = nodes, bonds = edges. GNNs (MPNN, SchNet, DimeNet, ChemProp) routinely top MoleculeNet leaderboards; the inductive bias matches chemistry's locality.

@@T0@@Recommender systems.@@T1@@ User-it.zh: @@T0@@推荐系统。@@T1@@用户-物品二部图；节点嵌入通过消息传递学习。PinSage（Pinterest）、基于 GraphSAGE 的流程支撑着生产级推荐系统。
@@T0@@Recommender systems.@@T1@@ User-it.src: Recommender systems. User-item bipartite graph; node embeddings learnt by message passing. PinSage (Pinterest), GraphSAGE-based pipelines power production recommenders.

@@T0@@Traffic forecasting.@@T1@@ Road ne.zh: @@T0@@交通预测。@@T1@@道路网络 + 交通计数器；时空 GNN（DCRNN、STGCN、Graph WaveNet）在全城范围预测上优于纯时间序列模型。
@@T0@@Traffic forecasting.@@T1@@ Road ne.src: Traffic forecasting. Road network + traffic counters; spatio-temporal GNNs (DCRNN, STGCN, Graph WaveNet) outperform pure time-series models for citywide forecasting.

@@T0@@Knowledge graphs.@@T1@@ Relational.zh: @@T0@@知识图谱。@@T1@@关系型 GNN（R-GCN、CompGCN）用于异构知识库中的链接预测。
@@T0@@Knowledge graphs.@@T1@@ Relational.src: Knowledge graphs. Relational GNNs (R-GCN, CompGCN) for link prediction in heterogeneous knowledge bases.

@@T0@@Power-grid / sensor networks.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@电网 / 传感器网络。@@T1@@节点为传感器 / 站点；边为物理连接或空间邻近关系。GNN 可插补缺失读数、标记异常传感器、传播警报。
@@T0@@Power-grid / sensor networks.@@T1@.src: Power-grid / sensor networks. Nodes = sensors/stations; edges = physical connections or spatial proximity. GNNs interpolate missing readings, flag anomalous sensors, propagate alerts.

@@T0@@Social and citation networks.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@社交与引文网络。@@T1@@开启该领域的 Cora / Citeseer / Pubmed 基准；至今仍是标准基线。
@@T0@@Social and citation networks.@@T1@.src: Social and citation networks. The Cora / Citeseer / Pubmed benchmarks that started the field; still standard baselines.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n I.zh: @@T0@@最终结论。@@T1@@若你的数据中含有图结构，请先构建 GNN 而非 MLP。归纳偏置是白得的；表达能力上限更高；而过平滑是唯一真正的隐患。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n I.src: Final takeaway. If your data has a graph in it, build the GNN before the MLP. The inductive bias is free; the expressive ceiling is higher; and over-smoothing is the only real footgun.

@@T0@@Kipf &amp; Welling (2017)@@T1@@ &m.zh: @@T0@@Kipf 与 Welling (2017)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks.@@T3@@GCN 论文。
@@T0@@Kipf &amp; Welling (2017)@@T1@@ &m.src: Kipf & Welling (2017) — Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks. The GCN paper.

@@T0@@Hamilton, Ying, Leskovec (2017)@@T.src: Hamilton, Ying, Leskovec (2017) — Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs. GraphSAGE.

@@T0@@Xu, Hu, Leskovec, Jegelka (2019)@@.zh: @@T0@@Xu、Hu、Leskovec、Jegelka (2019)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?@@T3@@GIN 与 WL 之间的联系。
@@T0@@Xu, Hu, Leskovec, Jegelka (2019)@@.src: Xu, Hu, Leskovec, Jegelka (2019) — How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks? GIN + WL connection.

@@T0@@Hamilton (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Grap.zh: @@T0@@Hamilton (2020)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Graph Representation Learning@@T3@@教材。可免费在线阅读。

@@T0@@PyG &amp; DGL@@T1@@ — the two prod.zh: @@T0@@PyG 与 DGL@@T1@@ — 两个生产级库。二者均内置上述每一个模型以及各种采样方法。
@@T0@@PyG &amp; DGL@@T1@@ — the two prod.src: PyG & DGL — the two production libraries. Both ship every model above and the sampling methods.
